decisions.reason: The same source message changes the Zebra design to a small black border, but that impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
The client asks whether the freelancer is comfortable using the previously chosen Pantone colors but does not change the existing color specification or workflow.
The mustard border applies specifically to the Weave design; the statement about moving to the block-print stage does not modify the mustard block-color pareo.
The source does not change the terracotta block-color pareo; it only indicates that block-print work may proceed afterward.
Proceeding to final artwork advances the existing work but does not alter the requirement to provide final production-ready artwork files.
